# CoreBlow Copilot Instructions

When working on this repository, follow the guidelines in `AGENTS.md` at the repo root.

Key rules:
- Use CoreBlow branding (not OpenClaw)
- TypeScript ESM, strict typing, no `any`
- Prefer Bun for TS execution
- Run `pnpm check` before committing
- Follow the commit message format: `scope: action description`
- Keep files under ~700 LOC
- Use American English
